simple.summary: כַּנֶּה (Kanneh) means Canneh , a place in Assyria First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 23.

definitions.full: H3656. Kanneh כַּנֶּה proper name, of a location apparently in Mesopotamia, וְכ חָרָן ׳וָעֶדֶן Ezek 27:23 , ᵐ5 Ξαναα ; identification dubious; = כַּלְנֶה Thes and most; Co rds. כַּלְנֶה ; Mez Stadt Harrân 34 proposes עֶדֶן בְּנֵי . כְּנָוֺת see כְּנָת p. 490. כָּנְיָהוּ see יְהוֺיָכִין p. 220, and יְכוֺנְיָה below כון . כִּנִּם כִֶּנָּם, see IV. כֵּן below II. כנן . below I. כנן (√ of following; parallel form of כון ; be firm, substantial ).
